gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads openly, its lowercase counters like wide portholes.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic brings a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves, tight above but generous inside. A long passage should read steadily.
